panels.description: Fraction of secret cache lookups served from cache: HIT / (HIT + MISS), per store. The cache-first signal for this benchmark — a cache-first run should climb toward 1, a store-miss run stays low. Emitted by CaffeineSecretCache (PR #59861).

panels.description: Distinct secret names the gateway actually looks up per resolve request. The gateway collapses in-batch duplicate references into a distinct set before the store/cache is consulted (server-side de-duplication), so this reads below the driver's batchSize by the duplicateRatio: e.g. batchSize=20 with duplicateRatio=0.3 collapses ~6 refs and reads ~14. Set duplicateRatio=0 and it rises to the full batchSize. This is where DUPLICATE_RATIO's effect shows up — not on the cache hit rate, since deduped references never reach the cache.
panels.title: Distinct store lookups per resolve (server-side dedup)

options.content:
### Reading the dedup panel

`duplicateRatio` does **not** show up as cache hits — the gateway collapses the repeated references in each resolve batch into a distinct set **before** the cache is consulted, so a duplicate never becomes a `HIT`.

Read the left panel against the driver's **`batchSize`** (see the *Driver configuration* panel):

- `batchSize=20`, `duplicateRatio=0.3` → collapses `round(20×0.3)=6` refs → panel reads **≈14**
- `duplicateRatio=0` → reads the full **20**

The gap between the line and `batchSize` is exactly the de-duplication the gateway performed.

panels.title: How to read distinct lookups per resolve
